notes:
2026-10-17: Another Claude session (cwd ~/PROJECT) committed jmap-chat-spec 0b2ee28 'feat: add MIMI alignment and read expiry' (+42/-9 in draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md and -federation-00.md): pins mimi-content-09/protocol-06/room-policy-04/mahy-mimi-message-status-01 refs; MIMI expired/hidden/error statuses are not read acks (no readAt); adds expiresAfterReadSeconds; attachment keys come from E2EE scheme; read-triggered deletion decoupled from senderExpiresAt in Peer/deliver. 2026-10-18: drafting of the draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 extension is being done by Mark in jmap-chat-spec (see .12 notes); this bead should track/align with that, not write it independently.
Draft gaps from the J1-J6 check vs 5630c10 (2026-10-18), for Mark's next draft revision: (1) topicId: base64url of a MIMI topicId over 191 octets exceeds base's 255-byte cap; no rule; also an empty MIMI topicId gives '' but base requires non-empty; and there is no outbound rule (client topicId to MIMI bytes; client strings like ULIDs aren't canonical base64url). mimid agent drops oversize topics (.13.4).
